From Justice · Price: only creatures with an open wound.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 2 actions: fog in a 20-ft area within 30 ft for 1 minute: wounded creatures in it take –1 status to attack rolls.
  • 5: Surge: control a wounded creature's next action (@Check[will|against:stand|traits:incapacitation]{Will}, incapacitation).
  • 9: Fog area 30 ft.
  • 13: The fog can make illusions of buildings or crowds.
  • 17: Control two creatures.

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
